meta.name: Assassin
meta.title: Assassin Ascension Planner
meta.sub: AION 2 Global · PvE Heart Gore build · exact skill points and Daevanion crystals, level by level
meta.blurb: Melee burst DPS from behind. Hold Quick Slice and a three-skill Insignia Explosion macro.

text.levels: Cost to raise a skill one level: 1 point each for levels 2–4, 2 each for 5–7, 4 each for 8–10 (13 to reach 8, 21 to reach 10). Each skill level also waits for a character-level gate (Heart Gore reaches 8 at 22 and 10 at 28). Levels alone give 203 points by 45; Wisdom Stones from district quests and sealed dungeons add 180 more for the 45 build. Board nodes count toward Specialty levels, so with this crystal plan Quick Slice's first pick opens at 18, Heart Gore's at 19 and Insignia Explosion's at 26.
text.schedule: Heart Gore's and Insignia Explosion's nodes first on each board as it opens, then Combat Speed, Quick Slice and Savage Roar on Nezekan, and Quick Slice, Savage Roar and the two Damage Boost nodes on Zikel. That uses 115 crystals; the 21 left at 45 start the quest-and-dungeon list (Assault Stance and Rear Smite on Nezekan). Skip Ambush, Infiltrate, Defiance, Whirlwind Slice, Shadow Fall, Damage Tolerance, Multi-Hit Resist, Critical Damage Tolerance, MP and Critical Hit Resist except where the route passes through one.
text.build: At 45, reset (free) and spend in this order. Levels alone pay for rows 1–6 (202 of your 203 points); Wisdom Stones pay for the rest, and row 13 uses the last point. Leave at 1: Shadow Fall, Apply Poison and Revitalization Contract. Shadowstrike and Whirlwind Slice stop at 8, where their picks open; Shadowstrike's board nodes take it to 12. Some take Shadowstrike to 10 with 8 of Defiance's points, which leaves Defiance at 8, where its pick opens.
text.passives: Rear Smite raises your Back Attack Damage Boost, so fight from behind. Above 10 the passives grow from their board nodes (4 each by 316 crystals), Arcana lines and Soul Binding lines. Swift Contract makes Rear Smite count ×1.5 from Stigma level 10 and Assault Stance from 15; Illusive Clone does the same for Exploit Weakness from 15.
text.specs: Skill levels past 10 come from Daevanion nodes (+1 each), Arcana cards and gear lines. A second pick opens at skill level 12; the level-16 option takes one of your two slots, and a third slot opens at 20. First 16s to chase: Heart Gore (cooldown reset on a Critical Hit), then Insignia Explosion (−3s cooldown) and Quick Slice (lands as a Critical Hit), then Storm Rampage (−1s all skill cooldowns on hit).
text.stigmaSub: 30 points at 45: Illusive Clone 10, the rest 5
text.stigma: Points go to Illusive Clone first: with the other three at 1 it reaches 10 at 39 (18 points), then the next points take the others to 5. Throw Shadowblade holds slot 4 while you quest; at 45 put Savage Fang there for stagger checks, or Evasion Stance where a boss's hits keep catching you. One preset cannot hold both at 5, so keep the other in a second skill preset or reset between fights (free). For farming, a preset with Throw Shadowblade at 10 resets its cooldown on each kill. After 45, Triniel's Dagger to 10 first (−10% all skill cooldowns on hit).
text.src: Where guides disagree (the fourth Stigma, Shadowstrike at 8 or 10, a few Specialty picks, board order) this planner follows Aion 2 Maps, whose stepper is computed from the client's level gates and point curve. Numbers can change with patches; the in-game tooltip wins.

Quick Slice.role: Basic-attack chain, hits up to 4. Hold it with the macro key the whole fight.

spec.8: Absorbs 0.7% HP; from 12 add -1s [Insignia Explosion] cooldown on hit
spec.16: Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit, in place of +50% Multi-Hit
spec.45: +50% Multi-Hit on hit and -1s [Insignia Explosion] cooldown on hit

Shadowstrike.role: Teleports you behind a target up to 20 m and stuns 3 s. Press it on cooldown.

spec.8: +20% caster Critical Damage Boost for 10s on hit
spec.45: Keep; from 12 add 50% chance to inflict Seal for 5s on hit

Savage Roar.role: Three-step chain; each hit engraves an Insignia. Last in the macro.

spec.8: +20% Skill Speed (or -20% MP consumed while MP runs short)
spec.16: Its level-16 option (a pull) stays off
spec.45: +20% Skill Speed and -1s [Shadowstrike] cooldown on hit

Ambush.role: Hits 30% harder from behind. Own key or leave it out: in the macro it stutters.

spec.45: Keep Absorbs 3% HP; from 12 add Engraves 2 Insignias for 10s on landing as a Back attack

Heart Gore.role: Main damage. Fires only after a Critical Hit, 5 s cooldown. Second in the macro.

spec.8: Absorbs 0.7% HP; from 12 (level 28) add Multi-Hit on hit
spec.16: Resets [Heart Gore] cooldown on landing a Critical Hit, in place of the Critical Hit pick
spec.45: Multi-Hit on hit and Up to +20% Critical Hit when less targets hit

Storm Rampage.role: Hits only a staggered target. Mash it in stagger windows.

spec.16: -1s all skill cooldowns on hit, in place of the absorb
spec.45: Keep Absorbs 5% HP; Multi-Hit on hit joins at 12

Whirlwind Slice.role: Press it right after you evade an attack.

Flash Slice.role: Takes you to the far side of the boss, behind it, when you end up in front.

Infiltrate.role: Gets you back behind the target after a Dodge.

spec.45: +10m [Infiltrate] range; from 12 add Restores 300 Stamina on landing [Infiltrate]

Shadow Fall.role: Dash to a stunned target and knock it down 3 s. PvP only; leave at 1.

Insignia Explosion.role: Hits harder per Insignia, up to 5; five stun a pack. Fires first in the macro.

spec.16: -3s cooldown, in place of the Insignia stacks pick
spec.45: +50% Multi-Hit on hit and Keep 2 stacks of Insignias after [Insignia Explosion]

Defiance.role: Breaks stun, grab and knockdown, then 5 s of status immunity.

Heightened Sixth Sense.role: Passive; raised with Wisdom Stones at 45 (row 11).

Exploit Weakness.role: Crits sometimes summon a clone that adds an Insignia. Third passive.

Rear Smite.role: Raises Back Attack Damage Boost. Top passive.

Assault Stance.role: Second passive; takes the 22 points left unspent before 45.

Impact Hit.role: Adds Double Chance and Impact-type Chance. Fourth passive.

Ambush Stance.role: Passive; raised with Wisdom Stones at 45 (row 9).

Defense Break.role: Stunned or knocked-down targets lose Defense and Status Effect Resist.

Determination.role: Passive; raised with Wisdom Stones at 45 (row 9).

Shadow Walk.role: 20 s of Stealth to close in unseen. PvP swap.

Savage Fang.role: Five Insignias and 50 stagger on up to 4. Slot 4 at 45 for stagger checks.

Evasion Contract.role: Frees you from Root and Slow, +200 Evasion. The PvP fourth Stigma.

Swift Contract.role: +20% Combat Speed for 12 s every 60 s. Slot 2; press before the clone.

Assault Ambush.role: Not used in the PvE build.

Throw Shadowblade.role: 20 m throw, 15 stagger. Slot 4 while questing; at 10 a kill resets it.

Shadowstep.role: A hit that jumps you back into 3 s of Stealth. PvP swap.

Smoke Bomb.role: Blind for 5 s, 15 stagger. PvP swap.

Triniel's Dagger.role: 4 m hit, 30% harder from behind, raises the target's cooldowns. Slot 3.

Aerial Bind.role: 20 stagger damage. Not used in the PvE build.

Evasion Stance.role: Evades all damage for 2 s. Slot 4 instead of Savage Fang when hits keep landing.

Spiral Slice.role: 20 m rush that removes buffs. PvP swap.

Illusive Clone.role: Lifts Heart Gore's cooldown and adds 20% damage for 14.5 s every 90 s. Slot 1.

18.note: Quick Slice counts as 8 with its new Nezekan node: its pick can go in now

19.note: Heart Gore counts as 8 with its Nezekan node: take Absorbs 0.7% HP now instead of at 22

22.note: Stigma slot 1: Illusive Clone. Needs the Ascension quest The One Who Hears the Voice, which also pays your first Stigma point

26.note: Insignia Explosion counts as 8 with its two board nodes: take +50% Multi-Hit on hit now

28.note: Heart Gore counts as 12 with two board nodes: add Multi-Hit on hit as its second pick

33.note: Quick Slice counts as 12 with Zikel's node: add -1s [Insignia Explosion] cooldown on hit

37.note: Stigma slot 4: Throw Shadowblade while questing (Savage Fang or Evasion Stance at 45)

39.note: Illusive Clone can reach Stigma level 10 now (18 points with the other three at 1)

45.keep: 22 unspent go into the 45 build. Reset (free) into the Build order
45.note: Azphel (PvP) board opens. Reset skills and Stigmas into the 45 build and swap to the 45 Specialties

stigmas.name: Illusive Clone
stigmas.why: Heart Gore without its cooldown and 20% of your damage again for 14.5 s every 90 s; at 5 +10% Status Effect Chance; at 10 +20% Critical Damage Boost while it lasts

stigmas.name: Swift Contract
stigmas.why: +20% Combat Speed for 12 s every 60 s; at 5 −20% MP Cost while it lasts

stigmas.name: Triniel's Dagger
stigmas.why: 4 m hit, 30% harder from behind, raises the target's skill cooldowns by 5%, every 45 s; at 5 usable on the move

stigmas.name: Savage Fang
stigmas.why: Five Insignias and 50 stagger on up to 4 within 4 m, every 60 s. Throw Shadowblade here while questing; Evasion Stance instead when a boss's hits keep catching you

macro.title: Boss setup: two inputs
macro.eyebrow: hold these down for the whole fight

blocks.text: Only the macro key is stacked. Bind it first: on Global's keyboard layout it starts unbound. Set Settings → Info Display → Combat → Display Boss Orientation Indicator to BACK so you always see where behind is.

items.sub: Your basic-attack chain. It fills every gap between skills. Not in the macro.

items.label: The macro (1 entry, 3 skills)
items.sub: One key that fires the 3 skills in the next box, in numbered order, 10 ms apart.

blocks.text: The number is the firing order, so put Insignia Explosion at the bottom of the line in the game's editor. Keep the macro to this line and at most one more entry: Savage Fang first, so the opening Insignia Explosion has five Insignias, or Storm Rampage second for staggers. Keep Skill Queue on.

macro.title: Not in any macro: press by hand

items.why: The Contract first, then the clone, from behind. Not just before a mechanic you will have to run from.
Each time it is back, for its 10 s Critical Damage buff.
Right after the buffs. In the macro it fires too early and wastes its cooldown.
Before you hold the keys (or as the macro's first entry), so Insignia Explosion opens on five Insignias.
Optional: on its own key, from behind, each time it is back. In the line it makes you stutter.

macro.title: Only when the moment comes
macro.eyebrow: single presses, not in the macro

items.why: While the boss is staggered: mash it while you hold the macro key, or add it as the macro's second entry. It only hits a staggered target.
When you end up in front of the boss: it takes you to the far side, behind it.
After a Dodge, to get back behind the target (up to 20 m with its range pick).
Right after you evade an attack.
If it is in Savage Fang's slot: just before a hit lands.
When a boss stuns, grabs or knocks you down. It frees you, then you are immune to status effects for 5 s.

blocks.text: All from behind the boss. Shadowstrike goes in whenever it is back. While the clone lasts (14.5 s at Stigma 10) Heart Gore has no cooldown, so it fires after every crit: this is your burst window.

items.text: There is too much in the macro. Go back to the one line and at most one more entry.

items.b: The Storm Rampage entry costs you hits.
items.text: Take it out and mash Storm Rampage by hand in staggers.
Keep it off the line, on its own key, or leave it out.
It needs a Critical Hit first. Take Critical Hit up to the cap.

blocks.text: Hold the keys yourself: the in-game macro comes out level with mouse-software setups, or at worst about 5% behind.

macro.title: Packs and questing
macro.eyebrow: a second skill preset for the open world

blocks.text: Make a separate preset for questing and farming. It keeps its own skill and Stigma levels and its own macro. You cannot switch presets while a Stigma is cooling down.

items.why: Same two keys as on a boss: each of these hits up to four enemies, so pull small packs.
With five Insignias on them it stuns every monster it hits.
In Savage Fang's slot, at Stigma 10 in this preset: each kill resets its cooldown.

blocks.text: You are fragile early: lean on the absorb picks and potions. If a story boss keeps killing you, do side quests for gear first.

arcana.note: Chalice and Parchment of Vigor with the Bell and Mirror of Magic: both two-card bonuses, +60 PvE Attack while your HP is 70% or more and 1,500 MP back when your MP drops to 20%.

alts.text: Compass of Magic (Death: Critical Hit) in place of Freedom; no set bonus changes.
Mirror of Vigor (Illusion): with the Compass of Vigor that is four Vigor cards and +150 PvE Attack, in place of Wisdom and the MP refill.
